description: This file defines base classes and utility functions for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM JavaScript components, including class inheritance, date/time utilities, and core class structures.

classes.name: SugarClass
classes.description: Superclass for all Sugar* subclasses, providing inheritance and initialization methods.

classes.name: SugarContainer
classes.description: Root class for Sugar JS Application, manages container initialization and startup.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: Utility class providing date and time functions, including parsing, formatting, and timezone adjustments.

methods.name: mysql2jsDateTime
methods.description: Converts MySQL date/time strings to JavaScript Date objects.

methods.name: getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string based on user preferences.

methods.name: getFormattedDOW
methods.description: Returns the day of week in a formatted string.

methods.name: getAMPM
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' based on the time.

methods.name: parseUTCDate
methods.description: Parses a UTC date string into a JavaScript Date object.

methods.name: parseAdjustedDate
methods.description: Adjusts a date based on DST and timezone offsets.

methods.name: getUTCHash
methods.description: Creates a hash string based on a date's UTC components.
